title: The Quiver's optic is built in SOL-82's register: four phases, an inner box that closes on the held body, a TARGET LOCKED blink and telemetry in the margins
context: The owner asked while playtesting for the Quiver's reticle to come closer to the Orbital Laser's: more exciting, moving elements, colour that changes, tracking within the tracking, a blinking confirmation that the lock was acquired, more telemetry. The lock RULES were fought for on 2026-09-13 ('agency is legibility') and could not move: whatever sits inside the lock square is the target, the timer runs while it stays there, and the square is drawn at the seeker's true angular cone (STORY_QUIVER.coneDeg projected through the camera's own field of view). So this is presentation only - no timing, cone, range or targeting rule was touched, and the reticle must not claim anything the seeker does not take.
outcome: src/fx/story-scope.js is rewritten from an SVG reticle plus a DOM field panel into one 2D canvas drawn each frame from a plain frame object, in the idiom of src/fx/laser-inset-hud.js. Four phases carry their own colour and motion: SEARCHING drifts a wide segmented ring in dim cyan with nothing held; TRACKING tightens the ring and speeds it up as the timer fills, in bright cyan; LOCKED snaps it still and blinks the tag in white; AWAY counter-turns it slowly while a round flies and stops the blink. Amber is left for warnings only (out of range, the launcher holding while its TALON is in the air). Tracking within the tracking: the true-size square is unchanged and a second box of corner brackets converges from its edge onto the held body's own projected point on the glass, fed from the same enemy the lock holds, with a dashed tether while it closes. The TARGET LOCKED blink floors at a third of full brightness so a still frame still reads as locked, and a short laser_click (an existing cue, nothing newly pinned) ticks once when the lock takes. Telemetry sits in plated blocks in the margins beside the sight, never over the square: SEEKER (cone in degrees, magnification, reach), LAUNCHER (state, rounds in flight, cooldown, trigger armed or safe) and TRACK (contact, type and belt from BELT_OF, range in metres, bearing, time to lock with its meter). prefers-reduced-motion drops every spin and blink and names the phase in words instead. src/td-tab.js stayed at its 13,505-line budget: the call site and the pilot test API grew only within existing lines, and the dead DOM panel's CSS came out of styles.css. The acceptance probe gained __stalheartPilotTest.lock() and aimSky() so the run can stand in each phase deliberately, and --quiver-frame now saves SEARCHING, TRACKING, LOCKED and the round away as screenshots.
alternatives: Keep the SVG reticle and animate it. Rejected: the phases need per-frame motion and the existing code only rebuilt innerHTML when the meter bucket changed, so every spin or blink would have meant rebuilding the whole markup each frame.

Keep the DOM TRACK panel beside a canvas reticle. Rejected: two rendering paths for one instrument, and the owner asked for the laser HUD's register, which is plated monospace blocks tucked around the scope.

Size the inner box from the body's true angular size. Rejected for now: the honest subtense is not plumbed to the seat, and a guessed size would make the reticle claim something about what the seeker takes. The inner box converges to a small fixed bracket on the body's point instead, and the outer square remains the only size statement.

Draw the LOCKED blink over the whole sight. Rejected after looking at the first screenshots: it caught TARGET LOCKED at a fifth of its brightness, so the state that matters most was the hardest to see. Only the tag and the closing box blink now.
evidence: npm test: 120 test programs passed. npm run check green (architecture: 87 pure-layer modules, line budgets hold; src/td-tab.js is still 13505 lines).

scripts/browser-lock.sh node scripts/browser-test.mjs --quiver-frame: green. PASS quiver-scope-searching, quiver-scope-tracking, quiver-scope-locked, quiver-scope-away, and all twelve quiver-frame view captures. The round still stays in frame: pov 148 of 148 from launch to ignite (100.0%), third 152 of 152 (100.0%).

artifacts/browser/quiver-scope-{searching,tracking,locked,away}.png are the four phases; they were read, and the blink floor, the ring's gaps at full lock and the phase word's position above the seat's views strip were changed in response.

scripts/browser-lock.sh node scripts/browser-test.mjs --story-world: reached story-world-rotor-kill and then failed the Rotor heat-peak assertion (peak 0.041 against a 0.05 floor) BEFORE the Quiver section, which is the intermittent sampling failure already recorded in docs/STATE.md on 2026-09-16. Nothing in this change touches rotor heat, and the same quiver-piloting beat (lock, fire, flight) is exercised green by --quiver-frame. The Quiver steps of --story-world were not reached and remain unverified on this branch.
